about: types already expanded to their subtypes, and a place in the hierarchy
sql: SELECT o.id FROM objects o WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.id IN (SELECT object_id FROM object_types WHERE type_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))) AND o.id IN (WITH RECURSIVE below(id) AS (SELECT id FROM objects WHERE parent_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM objects c JOIN below ON c.parent_id = below.id) SELECT id FROM below) ORDER BY o.title COLLATE NOCASE DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
